backend/main.mo: Actor implementing user profiles and editable page content with access control, including default home and contact pages and CRUD operations for pages.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module adding a default contact page and merging it with existing page content during upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing affected frontend files and components for ensuring contact info is displayed with clickable links.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and styles defining light and dark mode color tokens and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point bootstrapping the React app with the Mastermind Study Circle title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with six routes wrapped in a shared site layout.
frontend/src/components/Admin/AdminAcces: Gate component enforcing Internet Identity login and admin role checks before rendering admin content.
frontend/src/components/Admin/contentDef: Defines default editable content values for home hero text and contact information.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Site footer showing institute info, quick links, and contact details with clickable email and phone when valid.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Responsive site header with logo and navigation, adding an Admin link when authenticated and admin.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, and routed page content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthz.ts: Determines authentication and admin status using Internet Identity and actor queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth client, login/logout handling, and identity context persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future backend-related React Query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteContent.ts: Fetches and updates page content via the actor and normalizes legacy homepage values.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind configuration defining theme variables, styles, and light/dark mode tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page presenting the center’s mission, approach, and feature cards.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin-only page that loads home and contact content, allows editing through forms, and saves changes via updatePage mutations. Includes logout and status handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdmissionsCoachingPag: Displays admissions and coaching services along with a contact form that resets after submission. Pulls contact details from site content hooks.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page showing dynamic headline/subheadline content, a hero banner, mission preview, and feature highlights. Links guide users to admissions and vision pages.
frontend/src/pages/NiosStreamsSubjectsPa: Static informational page explaining NIOS streams, subjects, and program structure. Includes stream overview cards and expandable content sections.
frontend/src/pages/VisionPage.tsx: Long-form vision and mission page with inspirational messaging and cards explaining NIOS benefits. Provides structured sections with headings and supportive content.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read, store, and clear URL/query parameters and persist them in sessionStorage, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, requirements, issues, and features for building the Mastermind Study Circle website.
